excerpts: You play as the Soldier class.
sources.fact: Official ME2 PC manual identifies iconic Shepard as Soldier and lists Soldier Adrenaline Rush/Concussive Shot separately from Sentinel Tech Armor and Adept Singularity. This validates the selected class boundary, not an omni-blade or Mako attack.
ME2 Soldier kit includes both active combat powers and assault-rifle training. M-8 Avenger is the chosen compatible rifle.

Garrus has Concussive Shot and Overload, assault/sniper rifle training and compatible M-92 Mantis. Overload unlocks after Concussive Shot rank2. No Concussive Mine or Archangel Killbox is in this listed kit.

excerpts: DLC Required Lair of the Shadow Broker
sources.fact: DLC Liara has Singularity, Warp, Asari Scientist and Stasis, uses pistol/SMG, and can carry the M-3 Predator. Selected white-blue DLC outfit is explicitly named in prompts; exact texture/frame reproduction is not asserted.

excerpts: An explosive shot knocks down and damages your opponents, leaving them open for additional attacks.
sources.fact: Ordinary Concussive Shot and the optional area Concussive Blast evolution are distinct. The project explicitly selects ordinary single-target Shot for Shepard/Garrus; finite kinetic round from held weapon, not an indefinite energy beam.

excerpts: Boosts your combat awareness for a brief time, slowing your enemies by comparison.
sources.fact: Original Adrenaline Rush has time-dilation mechanics. The project instead uses a disclosed short self-only attack buff1.12× for3seconds; it never changes the shared clock or buffs unrelated callers.

excerpts: You launch a dark energy sphere to create an intense mass effect field; enemies are drawn into the singularity and held briefly helpless.
sources.fact: Singularity is a localized biotic sphere/field with pulling/holding behavior. Project area damage is condensed gameplay adaptation; no fake hacking data storm or claim of original long-duration physics.

excerpts: A mass effect field damages enemy targets and stops health regeneration.
sources.fact: Warp is a biotic offensive power; selected as finite targeted secondary. The runtime does not newly implement source-game regeneration suppression or full combo detonation here.
Tali has Combat Drone and uses ordinary pistols/shotguns. Her sealed suit and chosen purple hood remain distinct from the deployed technical projection.

sources.fact: Attack Drone evolution can damage target health with electric shocks. Explosive Drone instead explodes when destroyed, so an ordinary deployment is not an immediate group explosion. Runtime selects one condensed Attack Drone shock, not persistent AI aggro simulation.
